# Cart A board: HJ-840 pin map for the firmware (generated by `pinmap_cart_a.py` from `pin_assign.json`)

Same signals, functions and polarities as B (`../README.md` "HJ-840 pin assignment"); only pads move. A board file for the
firmware (`cart_a_v1.rs`, feature `board-cart-a-v1`) is generated like B's `cart_v1.rs` (`../sync_firmware_pins_cart.py`): not
done here (firmware out of scope of the board work). Machine-readable: `cart_a_pins.json`.

| HJ-840 pad | nRF pin | Net | Use | B pad (B nRF) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| C1 | P0.25 | `I2C_SDA` | TWIM | F3 (P0.11) |
| C8 | P1.12 | `MCU_EN` | out: hardware leg of the motor enable (AND3 U36), 100 k pull-down | E8 (P0.03) |
| D1 | P0.19 | `I2C_SCL` | TWIM: TMAG5273A1 U10 (0x35) on the board, 4.7 k pull-ups, 100 kHz | C6 (P0.13) |
| D2 | P1.00 | `SUP_RXD` | out: UART TX to the supervisor | F5 (P0.27) |
| D3 | P1.02 | `SUP_TXD` | in: UART RX from the supervisor | G5 (P0.05) |
| D8 | P0.31 | `DOCK_N` | in: adapter-lock detector switch SW2 via RLK, LOW = adapter locked (100 k pull-up RDK, 100 nF CLK to 3V3) | D8 (P0.31) |
| E2 | P0.15 | `MOT_FWD` | out: forward intent, HIGH = forward (pull-up: reset default = forward = blocked when not locked) | F8 (P0.29) |
| E3 | P0.16 | `ARM_CLK` | out: rising edge sets the latch and arms the supervisor, 100 k pull-down | F7 (P0.30) |
| E4 | P1.08 | `SUP_OK` | in: supervisor healthy | E7 (P0.28) |
| E6 | P0.02 | `SUP_BOOT0` | out: supervisor BOOT0 strap (100 k pull-down) | E2 (P0.15) |
| E7 | P0.28 | `OC_OK` | in: TPS2553 FAULT, low = current limit active (100 k pull-up) | F4 (P0.07) |
| E8 | P0.03 | `LED_B` | out, active low | D2 (P1.00) |
| F3 | P0.11 | `SUP_NRST` | io, OPEN DRAIN ONLY: pulls the supervisor NRST low | G3 (P0.12) |
| F4 | P0.07 | `LED_R` | out, active low (RGB common anode on VBAT, 1 k) | B1 (P0.22) |
| F5 | P0.27 | `LATCH_Q` | in: interlock latch readback | C8 (P1.12) |
| F7 | P0.30 | `BTN_N` | in: top button SW1, internal pull-up | C1 (P0.25) |
| F8 | P0.29 | `APHASE` | out: U7A DRV8838 PH, also supervisor input (PA1) | D7 (P1.13) |
| G3 | P0.12 | `BPHASE` | out: U7B DRV8838 PH, also supervisor input (PA13) | G4 (P1.09) |
| G4 | P1.09 | `LED_G` | out, active low | D1 (P0.19) |
| G5 | P0.05 | `CHG_STAT` | in: MCP73832 STAT, low = charging | G8 (P0.06) |
| G7 | P0.26 | `AENBL` | out: bridge A enable (1 = driven, 0 = brake) | C7 (P1.11) |
| G8 | P0.06 | `BUZ_A` | out: sounder NFET gate (100 k pull-down) | B8 (P1.14) |
| H5 | P0.08 | `BENBL` | out: bridge B enable | G7 (P0.26) |
| E1 | P0.18 | `NRST` | reset (UICR PSELRESET), TPL5010 RSTn | same |
| H7 | P0.04 | `VMOT_SENSE` | SAADC AIN2: motor supply after the load switch, 10 k / 10 k | same |
| F1/G1/F2 | D+ / D- / VBUS | `USB_DP / USB_DM / VBUS_P` | USB (DFU, charging) | same |
| C2/C3 | SWDIO / SWCLK | `SWDIO / SWDCLK` | pogo pads TPR1-4 (bottom) | same |
| H2 | VDDH | `VBAT` | the cell through the reverse-polarity P-FET Q1 | same |

Unused: row A (antenna; A1 GND, A7-A8 bridge), B2-B7, P0.00 / P0.01 (no 32 kHz crystal: LFRC), NFC pads.
